theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} [Field α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [Archimedean α] (f : α →+*o α) : f = OrderRingHom.id α := by
  -- Show that f(1) = 1
  have h1 : f 1 = 1 :=
    by
      rw [ring_hom.map_one]
      exact eq_of_idempotent (by simp) (by simp)
  
  -- Show that f(n) = n for all integers n
  let rec show_int : ℤ → α → Prop :=
    fun n x => by
      induction' n with n ih
      · exact (by rw [int.cast_zero])
      · exact (by rw [int.cast_add, ih n (f x), ih n x])
  
  -- Show that f fixes the interval [n, n + 1) for all integers n
  let rec show_interval : ℕ → α → Prop :=
    fun n x => by
      induction' n with n ih
      · exact (by rw [lt_iff_le_and_ne, int.cast_zero, int.cast_one, le_refl, ne_self_iff_false, false.elim])
      · exact (by rw [lt_iff_le_and_ne, int.cast_add, int.cast_one, int.cast_add, int.cast_one, ih n x, ih n x])
  
  -- Use the fact that the union of intervals [n, n + 1) covers α
  have h_cover : ∀ x : α, ∃ n : ℕ, x ∈ Set.Ico (↑n) (↑n + 1) :=
    by
      intro x
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := iUnion_Ico_intCast α
      exact ⟨n, hn x⟩
  
  -- Show that f(x) = x for all x ∈ α
  intro x
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h_cover x
  rw [OrderRingHom.id_apply]
  have h_n : f (↑n) = ↑n :=
    by
      apply show_int n
      exact (by rw [int.cast_zero])
  have h_x : f x = x :=
    by
      apply show_interval n x
      exact h_n
  exact h_x
